name: FlashArray - replicate now with approval
description: A purefa_pg_replication event forwarded by the replication rulebook: a protection group whose replication is overdue or whose transfer is stuck. A human approves an immediate replicated snapshot of the group; nothing is sent without that approval, the group's schedule is untouched, and every outcome is written to the alert log.

extra_vars.subject: Protection group ${trigger.event.data.pgroup} on ${trigger.event.array} is overdue or stuck; an immediate replicated snapshot awaits approval
extra_vars.detail: Last completed ${trigger.event.data.since_last_completed_s} s ago, schedule every ${trigger.event.data.frequency_ms} ms, in progress: ${trigger.event.data.in_progress}, targets ${trigger.event.data.targets}. Approve or reject in the orchestrator within one hour.

parameters.prompt: Protection group ${trigger.event.data.pgroup} on ${trigger.event.array}: replication is overdue or stuck (last completed ${trigger.event.data.since_last_completed_s} s ago, schedule every ${trigger.event.data.frequency_ms} ms). Approve to take an immediate snapshot of the group and replicate it to its targets now; the group's schedule is not changed. Rejecting sends nothing.

extra_vars.subject: ${trigger.event.array}: immediate replicated snapshot of ${trigger.event.data.pgroup} requested after approval
extra_vars.detail: Snapshot ${trigger.event.data.pgroup}.${replicate_now.artifacts.snapshot_suffix} sent to the group's targets (changed: ${replicate_now.artifacts.changed}). Job: ${replicate_now.job_url}

extra_vars.subject: Immediate replication of ${trigger.event.data.pgroup} on ${trigger.event.array} rejected or expired; nothing sent
extra_vars.detail: The group stays on its schedule (every ${trigger.event.data.frequency_ms} ms, last completed ${trigger.event.data.since_last_completed_s} s before the event). Check the array connection and the target if it stays overdue.
